subject: James, Lisan's brother: the adoption carried into writing continuity (CHARACTER_JAMES_20261014.md); canon kept to the record; the Hon lineage and review untouched; no image requested
body:
Your relay of Ziggy's decision (via Site Index) received; the adoption record read on disk and verified (ADOPTION_RECORD_396fad0e…, sha256 9e0543d7d8541730ec0a7a2c42086f8eaacb8e7df8f713f3ef1ccb9d00dfe6ff, 2,486 bytes); the source image verified at the Hon path (HD-RETURN-957897bd45c4, sha256 957897bd45c4fc03d685c4a40af7670385ab3970108cdbd319d839385dceacc1, 306,212 bytes) and viewed at full size; the Hon ledger entry read (a verified received candidate, not approved as Dolo; its note on the chest tattoo stays Hon's finding).

The continuity note is attached: CHARACTER_JAMES_20261014.md, sha256 faa31a88edc4525075e2ccce7a66b2bfdfe19c49d3a3b04f3e682456311dd7b4, 7,173 bytes. Section 1 holds only what the record makes canon (the character, the relationship, the exact look referenced in place, the gun-removal-only derivative pending Ziggy's review, the cross-project lineage with the Hon original and review intact, the record's unknowns: age, backstory, powers, future wardrobe). Section 2 describes the man as seen (curls, the smile, hoops in both ears, two chains, the open black overcoat over the tattooed chest, the holster, the hangar) and what he does not carry: none of Lisan's marks, which is the one continuity fact the picture itself supplies. Sections 3 to 5 are proposals, labeled, for Ziggy's direction: the sign skipped the brother; a brother with reach (the hangar is Hon's setting, not Lisan canon, and is read only as a suggestion); whether Angels and Sassy raised him too; a Panhandler without the sign or Angels' ally in doubt; the loop's proof at both ends; the gun stays gone and the holster stays empty unless Ziggy says otherwise; an episode table; five open questions (DECISIONS open item 21). Section 6: nothing of Hon Dolo's story comes with the picture; no image requested beyond the derivative already with Grok; no posted file edited; James enters no coverage set or shot card until Ziggy has read this and the derivative is accepted.

The shot-card structure stands as the basis for any James shot later, with his sides written both ways in the card and in frame terms in the prompt. DECISIONS item 56 records the decision (file sha256 ae9e8203a43fc80f375ff03840cc0658929d9c3b6213e0a5c10a557a9c0f7974); START_HERE.txt sha256 13aaa651c1253d7ada5711b1596eb052e27b5f6731832d0dc7c13769fd8f949e. A one-agent fact check of the note is running; any correction comes in this thread.
